The heart of a network. Touching Network Controllers form one structure: a single block, a line, or the hollow edge frame of a box up to 7x7x7 (a 3x3x3 frame is 20 blocks). Filled faces and anything bigger don't form. Each controller face with a network connection provides 32 lanes. crt.encodedlogistics.help.main:
The main menu. Type an option's number on the command line and press Enter, or click an option (double-click to go there). Any command can be typed on the command line too: an ELCL command, or a screen's own (WRKLIB, WRKMBR LIB(name), DSPMSG...). F4 there prompts it.

   1  Items in the network
   2  Crafting jobs (WRKCRFJOB)
   3  Devices on the network
   4  Storage, energy, lanes
   5  Libraries and source members
   6  Script jobs (WRKACTJOB)
   7  Your message queue
   8  Spooled output
  90  Sign off
crt.encodedlogistics.help.signon: Sign on to the system with your player name; no password is needed. The Firewall's permissions for you apply from then on. SECLVL 10 skips this screen.
crt.encodedlogistics.help.signon.user: User: your player name, in any case.
crt.encodedlogistics.help.signon.program: Program/procedure: a program to CALL straight after sign-on (LIB/NAME, or a name on your library list). Blank: none.
crt.encodedlogistics.help.signon.menu: Menu: the menu to start on. MAIN is the one there is.
crt.encodedlogistics.help.signon.library: Current library: where new members go and what WRKMBR shows when no library is given. *USRPRF: your profile's (ELGPL).
crt.encodedlogistics.help.wrklib:
Shows the libraries on this system. Type an option in the Opt column next to a library and press Enter.

  2=Change   Change the text or authority.
  4=Delete   Delete a library you own.
  5=Display  Show its attributes.
  12=Work with members  List the source members.

F6 creates a library (CRTLIB). ELSYS holds the samples and is read-only; ELGPL is for everyone.
crt.encodedlogistics.help.wrklib.opt: Opt: 2=Change (text, and public authority: *USE lets others read, *CHANGE lets them change members), 4=Delete (asks first), 5=Display, 12=Work with members. Several rows' options are done top to bottom.
crt.encodedlogistics.help.dsplib: A library's attributes: its owner, public authority, how many members it holds and their size. Press Enter or F12 to return.
crt.encodedlogistics.help.wrkmbr:
Shows the source members in a library. Type an option next to a member and press Enter.

  2=Edit     Open it in the source editor.
  3=Copy     Copy it to another library or name.
  4=Delete   Delete it (asks first).
  5=Display  Show it, read-only.
  6=Print    Print the source to Work with Output.
  7=Rename   Give it a new name.
  14=Compile Create its program; the listing goes to Work with Output.

Chg * means the source changed after it was compiled. F6 creates a member, F11 sorts.
crt.encodedlogistics.help.wrkmbr.opt: Opt: 2=Edit, 3=Copy, 4=Delete, 5=Display, 6=Print, 7=Rename, 14=Compile. In ELSYS only 3, 5, 6 and 14 (into a library of yours) work: it's read-only.
crt.encodedlogistics.help.cmdent: Type any ELCL command and press Enter: it runs in your interactive job and its messages show here (ID and text), with the values its RTN parameters return. The desk's own words (show, withdraw, craft, cancel job, help) still work as aliases. F4 prompts the command on the command line, Tab completes its last word, F9 brings back earlier commands, F13 clears this list.
crt.encodedlogistics.help.wrkinv: The network's items, hot and on tape. Type an option next to an item: 1=Withdraw, 5=Display details, 7=Craft. Position to: the starting characters of a name. F11 sorts by name, quantity or mod.
crt.encodedlogistics.help.wrkinv.opt: Opt: 1=Withdraw (to the desk drawer or your inventory), 5=Display details, 7=Craft (items a schematic makes).
crt.encodedlogistics.help.wrkcrfjob: The network's crafting jobs. 4=Cancel (Enter again to confirm), 5=Display its steps. Refreshes every two seconds.
crt.encodedlogistics.help.wrkdev: Every device on the network, with its lanes and status. 5=Display its details, 8=Locate it in the world. Scripts name devices as type and number (CTLIF01, UPS01...).
crt.encodedlogistics.help.wrkdev.opt: Opt: 5=Display, 8=Locate (it lights up for ten seconds).
crt.encodedlogistics.help.dspnetsts: Storage, energy, lanes, crafting and devices at a glance. Refreshes every two seconds. Press Enter to return.
crt.encodedlogistics.help.morekeys: Every key the screens take, and this terminal's phosphor: Green, Amber, White, or *SYSVAL to follow the system's PHOSPHOR value.
crt.encodedlogistics.help.prompt: Type a value in each field and press Enter. F4 lists a field's values, F10 shows the additional parameters, F5 resets them, F12 returns without the command.
